objective: Verify all 29 supported Mermaid families across at least 58 English and Chinese fixtures, ASCII and Unicode charsets, and maximum widths 100 and 120 (232 render combinations). Run all required checks, perform immutable Review, resolve every Issue, commit each reviewed unit, and complete the new Task. Preserve all completed Task history.
